submissions.comment: Treats the alphabet like a poorly balanced video game.
submissions.answer: Not enough vowels. It is like 21 consonants and only 5 vowels. The ratio is completely broken. Would not recommend.

submissions.comment: A bit basic but singling out Q is a nice touch.
submissions.answer: Too many letters, highly overrated. Especially Q, what is that even doing there? 1 star.

submissions.comment: Brilliant wordplay on characters and perfect review framing.
submissions.answer: I tried to read it but there is no plot. Just a bunch of characters introduced and then it ends with Z. Terrible pacing.
